baselineDisplay.title: Too High a Price?
baselineDisplay.question: What does the writer describe as an 'amusing old-fashioned source of noise'?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 作者将什么描述为“一种有趣的老式噪音来源”？
baselineDisplay.text:
What does the writer describe as an 'amusing old-fashioned source of noise'?

Editorial note: This reading corrects the textbook’s food-safety claims and removes statistics from an unidentified survey; the recording retains the original wording. Pollution is one of the costs of human activity on an increasingly crowded, industrialised planet.
We can reduce waste, reuse or recycle materials, burn waste, or dispose of it in landfill.
We keep trying all four methods, but the sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us.
Rubbish, however, is only part of the problem of polluting our planet.
Food production can also contribute to pollution, depending on how farming and waste are managed.
Industrial farming can produce large quantities of meat, but safe production requires effective controls.
Pesticides and fertilizers can support crop production, while their misuse can harm the environment.
Environmental pollution and foodborne disease are related concerns, but neither can simply be blamed on low food prices.
BSE is a prion disease first identified in British cattle in 1986 and linked to contaminated feed. Salmonella and Listeria are bacteria that can contaminate various foods, not just eggs or dairy products.
Organic production restricts the substances that may be used, but does not necessarily mean that no pesticides are used. Food safety depends on many factors, including handling, storage and compliance with residue limits.
However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban areas and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
False or repeated burglar alarms can annoy passers-by, although properly used alarms can serve a protective purpose.
Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street and are a source of profound irritation.
Among the noises that disturb people,
dogs barking repeatedly at night can be particularly intrusive.
The writer also lists many other unwelcome sounds:
Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks, noisy neighbours, vehicles of all kinds, especially large container trucks thundering through quiet villages, planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
New technology has also made its own contribution to noise.
A lot of people object to mobile phones, especially when they are used in public places like restaurants or on public transport.
Loud conversations on mobile phones invade our thoughts or interrupt the pleasure of meeting friends for a quiet chat.
The writer adds a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.
It is snoring, which can disturb the sleep of other people nearby.
People of different ages and sexes can snore.
The textbook’s percentages cannot be assessed without an identifiable study and population.
Frequent loud snoring can be a symptom of sleep apnoea, but snoring alone does not establish that diagnosis.
Whatever the source of noise, one thing is certain: silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
编者注：本文校正教材中的食品安全论述，并删除无法确认来源的调查数字；录音保留原文。污染是人类在日益拥挤、工业化的星球上活动所带来的代价之一。
我们可以减少垃圾、重复使用或回收材料、焚烧垃圾，或采用填埋处置。
我们一直在尝试这四种方法，但全球产生的垃圾数量实在庞大，几乎让我们应接不暇。
然而，垃圾仅仅是污染我们地球问题的一个方面罢了。
食品生产也可能造成污染，具体取决于农业和废弃物的管理方式。
工业化养殖可以生产大量肉类，但安全生产需要有效的管控。
农药和肥料有助于作物生产，但滥用可能损害环境。
环境污染与食源性疾病是相互关联的问题，但两者都不能简单归因于食品价格低廉。
BSE是一种朊病毒病，1986年首次在英国牛群中确认，与受污染饲料有关。沙门氏菌和李斯特菌是可污染多种食品的细菌，并非只涉及鸡蛋或乳制品。
有机生产限制可使用的物质，但并不一定意味着完全不用农药。食品安全取决于多种因素，包括处理、储存及是否符合残留限量。
然而，还有一种更为隐蔽的污染形式，它尤其影响城市地区，并渗透到我们的日常生活中，那就是噪音。
误报或反复响起的防盗警报会令路人烦恼，不过正确使用的警报也能起到防护作用。
汽车警报声在街上不断刺耳地鸣叫，令人极度烦躁。
在困扰人们的噪声中，
夜间反复的狗叫可能格外扰人。
作者还列出了许多其他令人不快的声音：
夏日里割草机的嗡嗡声、公寓楼里的深夜聚会……吵闹的邻居们，各种各样的车辆……尤其是那些巨大的集装箱卡车，在宁静的村庄里轰鸣着驶过……飞机和直升机在头顶上飞过；在公共场所，人们会携带大型收音机，并将音量调至最大来播放音乐。
新技术也为噪音问题做出了自己的“贡献”。
很多人反对在公共场所（如餐厅或公共交通工具上）使用手机。
手机上大声的通话声会干扰我们的思绪，或者打断我们与朋友安静交谈的乐趣。
作者还补充了一种令人意外、也许有点滑稽的老式噪声来源。
那就是打鼾，它可能妨碍附近其他人的睡眠。
不同年龄和性别的人都可能打鼾。
没有可识别的研究来源和调查人群，就无法评估教材中的那些百分比。
经常大声打鼾可能是睡眠呼吸暂停的一种症状，但不能仅凭打鼾就作出诊断。
无论噪音的来源是什么，有一点是肯定的：宁静似乎已经成为了一段珍贵的回忆。

display.title: Too High a Price
display.question: What does the writer describe as an 'amusing old-fashioned source of noise'?
display.questionZh: 作者将什么描述为“一种有趣的老式噪音来源”？
display.text:
What does the writer describe as an 'amusing old-fashioned source of noise'?

Pollution is the price we pay for an overpopulated, overindustrialized planet.
When you come to think about it, there are only four ways you can deal with rubbish: dump it, burn it, turn it into something you can use again, attempt to produce less of it.
We keep trying all four methods, but sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us.
Rubbish, however, is only part of the problem of polluting our planet.
The need to produce ever increasing quantities of cheap food leads to a different kind of pollution.
Industriallized farming metheods produce cheap meat products: beef, pork and chicken.
The use of pesticides and fertilizers produces cheap grain and vegetables.
The price we pay for cheap food may be already too high:
Mad Cow Disease (BSE) in cattle, salmonella in chicken and eggs, and listeria in dairy products.
And if you think you'll abandon meat and become a vegetarian, you have the choice of very expensive organically-grown vegetables or a steady diet of pesticides every time you think you're eating fresh salads and vegetables, or just having an innocent glass of water!
However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban area and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night serve only to annoy passers-by and actually assist burglars to burgle.
Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street and are a source of profound irritation.
A recent survey of the effects of noise revealed (surprisingly?)
that dogs barking incessantly in the night rated the highest form of noise pollution on a scale ranging from 1 to 7.
The survey revealed a large number of sources of noise that we really dislike.
Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks, noisy neighbours, vehicles of all kinds, especially large container trucks thundering through quiet villages, planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
New technology has also made its own contribution to noise.
A lot of people object to mobile phones, especially when they are used in public places like restaurant or on public transport.
Loud conversations on mobile phones invade our thoughts or interrupt the pleasure of meeting friends for a quiet chat.
The noise pollution survey revealed a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.
It turned out to be snoring! Men were found to be the worst offenders.
It was revealed that 20% of men in their mid-thirties snore.
This figure rises to a staggering 60% of men in their sixties.
Against these figures, it was found that only 5% of women snore regularly, while the rest are constantly woken or kept awake by their trumpeting partners.
Whatever the source of noise, one thing is certain: silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.

display.bodyTextZh:
污染是我们这个人口过剩、过度工业化的星球所必须付出的代价。
仔细想想，处理垃圾其实只有四种方法：把它扔掉、烧掉，或者把它改造成可以再次使用的东西；尽量减少它的生产量。
我们一直在尝试这四种方法，但全球产生的垃圾数量实在庞大，几乎让我们应接不暇。
然而，垃圾仅仅是污染我们地球问题的一个方面罢了。
对廉价食品日益增长的需求导致了另一种形式的污染。
工业化农业生产方式能够制造出价格低廉的肉类产品，包括牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉。
使用农药和化肥可以生产出价格低廉的谷物和蔬菜。
我们为廉价食品所支付的价格可能已经太高了。
牛的疯牛病（BSE）、鸡肉和鸡蛋中的沙门氏菌，以及乳制品中的李斯特菌。
如果你打算放弃吃肉、成为素食者，你也有选择：要么购买价格昂贵的有机蔬菜，要么每次以为自己在吃新鲜沙拉或蔬菜时，其实都在摄入农药；或者，你也可以选择简单地喝一杯水……
然而，还有一种更为隐蔽的污染形式，它尤其影响城市地区，并渗透到我们的日常生活中，那就是噪音。
防盗警报在日夜任何时候突然响起，不仅会惹恼路人，反而会帮助窃贼作案；
汽车警报声在街上不断刺耳地鸣叫，令人极度烦躁。
最近一项关于噪音影响的调查显示（令人惊讶的是），
夜间狗不停地吠叫被列为噪音污染中最严重的形式（在1到7的评分体系中得分最高）。
这项调查还揭示了许多我们非常讨厌的噪音来源：
夏日里割草机的嗡嗡声、公寓楼里的深夜聚会……吵闹的邻居们，各种各样的车辆……尤其是那些巨大的集装箱卡车，在宁静的村庄里轰鸣着驶过……飞机和直升机在头顶上飞过；在公共场所，人们会携带大型收音机，并将音量调至最大来播放音乐。
新技术也为噪音问题做出了自己的'贡献'。
很多人反对在公共场所（如餐厅或公共交通工具上）使用手机。
手机上大声的通话声会干扰我们的思绪，或者打断我们与朋友安静交谈的乐趣。
噪音污染调查显示了一个相当令人惊讶、甚至有点滑稽的老式噪音来源。
原来问题出在打鼾上！研究发现，男性是打鼾问题最严重的群体。
据调查显示，20%的三十多岁男性有打鼾的习惯。
而在六十多岁的男性中，这个数字惊人地高达60%。
与这些数据相比，研究发现只有5%的女性经常打鼾。而其余的女性则不断被她们如吹号般的伴侣吵醒或无法入睡。
无论噪音的来源是什么，有一点是肯定的：沉默似乎已经成为了一段珍贵的回忆。

sentences.zh: 仔细想想，处理垃圾其实只有四种方法：把它扔掉、烧掉，或者把它改造成可以再次使用的东西；尽量减少它的生产量。

sentences.en: We keep trying all four methods, but sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在尝试这四种方法，但全球产生的垃圾数量实在庞大，几乎让我们应接不暇。

sentences.en: Rubbish, however, is only part of the problem of polluting our planet.
sentences.zh: 然而，垃圾仅仅是污染我们地球问题的一个方面罢了。

sentences.en: The need to produce ever increasing quantities of cheap food leads to a different kind of pollution.
sentences.zh: 对廉价食品日益增长的需求导致了另一种形式的污染。

sentences.en: Industriallized farming metheods produce cheap meat products: beef, pork and chicken.
sentences.zh: 工业化农业生产方式能够制造出价格低廉的肉类产品，包括牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉。

sentences.en: The use of pesticides and fertilizers produces cheap grain and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 使用农药和化肥可以生产出价格低廉的谷物和蔬菜。

sentences.en: The price we pay for cheap food may be already too high:
sentences.zh: 我们为廉价食品所支付的价格可能已经太高了。

sentences.en: Mad Cow Disease (BSE) in cattle, salmonella in chicken and eggs, and listeria in dairy products.
sentences.zh: 牛的疯牛病（BSE）、鸡肉和鸡蛋中的沙门氏菌，以及乳制品中的李斯特菌。

sentences.en: And if you think you'll abandon meat and become a vegetarian, you have the choice of very expensive organically-grown vegetables or a steady diet of pesticides every time you think you're eating fresh salads and vegetables, or just having an innocent glass of water!
sentences.zh: 如果你打算放弃吃肉、成为素食者，你也有选择：要么购买价格昂贵的有机蔬菜，要么每次以为自己在吃新鲜沙拉或蔬菜时，其实都在摄入农药；或者，你也可以选择简单地喝一杯水……

sentences.en: However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban area and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
sentences.zh: 然而，还有一种更为隐蔽的污染形式，它尤其影响城市地区，并渗透到我们的日常生活中，那就是噪音。

sentences.en: Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night serve only to annoy passers-by and actually assist burglars to burgle.
sentences.zh: 防盗警报在日夜任何时候突然响起，不仅会惹恼路人，反而会帮助窃贼作案；

sentences.en: Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street and are a source of profound irritation.
sentences.zh: 汽车警报声在街上不断刺耳地鸣叫，令人极度烦躁。

sentences.en: A recent survey of the effects of noise revealed (surprisingly?)
sentences.zh: 最近一项关于噪音影响的调查显示（令人惊讶的是），

sentences.en: that dogs barking incessantly in the night rated the highest form of noise pollution on a scale ranging from 1 to 7.
sentences.zh: 夜间狗不停地吠叫被列为噪音污染中最严重的形式（在1到7的评分体系中得分最高）。

sentences.en: The survey revealed a large number of sources of noise that we really dislike.
sentences.zh: 这项调查还揭示了许多我们非常讨厌的噪音来源：

sentences.en: Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks, noisy neighbours, vehicles of all kinds, especially large container trucks thundering through quiet villages, planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
sentences.zh: 夏日里割草机的嗡嗡声、公寓楼里的深夜聚会……吵闹的邻居们，各种各样的车辆……尤其是那些巨大的集装箱卡车，在宁静的村庄里轰鸣着驶过……飞机和直升机在头顶上飞过；在公共场所，人们会携带大型收音机，并将音量调至最大来播放音乐。

sentences.en: New technology has also made its own contribution to noise.
sentences.zh: 新技术也为噪音问题做出了自己的'贡献'。

sentences.en: A lot of people object to mobile phones, especially when they are used in public places like restaurant or on public transport.
sentences.zh: 很多人反对在公共场所（如餐厅或公共交通工具上）使用手机。

sentences.en: Loud conversations on mobile phones invade our thoughts or interrupt the pleasure of meeting friends for a quiet chat.
sentences.zh: 手机上大声的通话声会干扰我们的思绪，或者打断我们与朋友安静交谈的乐趣。

sentences.en: The noise pollution survey revealed a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.
sentences.zh: 噪音污染调查显示了一个相当令人惊讶、甚至有点滑稽的老式噪音来源。

sentences.en: It turned out to be snoring! Men were found to be the worst offenders.
sentences.zh: 原来问题出在打鼾上！研究发现，男性是打鼾问题最严重的群体。

sentences.en: It was revealed that 20% of men in their mid-thirties snore.
sentences.zh: 据调查显示，20%的三十多岁男性有打鼾的习惯。

sentences.en: This figure rises to a staggering 60% of men in their sixties.
sentences.zh: 而在六十多岁的男性中，这个数字惊人地高达60%。

sentences.en: Against these figures, it was found that only 5% of women snore regularly, while the rest are constantly woken or kept awake by their trumpeting partners.
sentences.zh: 与这些数据相比，研究发现只有5%的女性经常打鼾。而其余的女性则不断被她们如吹号般的伴侣吵醒或无法入睡。

sentences.en: Whatever the source of noise, one thing is certain: silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.
sentences.zh: 无论噪音的来源是什么，有一点是肯定的：沉默似乎已经成为了一段珍贵的回忆。

Editorial note: This reading corrects the textbook’s food-safety claims and removes statistics from an unidentified survey; the recording retains the original wording. Pollution is one of the costs of human activity on an increasingly crowded, industrialised planet.
We can reduce waste, reuse or recycle materials, burn waste, or dispose of it in landfill.
We keep trying all four methods, but the sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us.
Rubbish, however, is only part of the problem of polluting our planet.
Food production can also contribute to pollution, depending on how farming and waste are managed.
Industrial farming can produce large quantities of meat, but safe production requires effective controls.
Pesticides and fertilizers can support crop production, while their misuse can harm the environment.
Environmental pollution and foodborne disease are related concerns, but neither can simply be blamed on low food prices.
BSE is a prion disease first identified in British cattle in 1986 and linked to contaminated feed. Salmonella and Listeria are bacteria that can contaminate various foods, not just eggs or dairy products.
Organic production restricts the substances that may be used, but does not necessarily mean that no pesticides are used. Food safety depends on many factors, including handling, storage and compliance with residue limits.
However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban areas and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
False or repeated burglar alarms can annoy passers-by, although properly used alarms can serve a protective purpose.
Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street and are a source of profound irritation.
Among the noises that disturb people,
dogs barking repeatedly at night can be particularly intrusive.
The writer also lists many other unwelcome sounds:
Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks, noisy neighbours, vehicles of all kinds, especially large container trucks thundering through quiet villages, planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
New technology has also made its own contribution to noise.
A lot of people object to mobile phones, especially when they are used in public places like restaurants or on public transport.
Loud conversations on mobile phones invade our thoughts or interrupt the pleasure of meeting friends for a quiet chat.
The writer adds a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.
It is snoring, which can disturb the sleep of other people nearby.
People of different ages and sexes can snore.
The textbook’s percentages cannot be assessed without an identifiable study and population.
Frequent loud snoring can be a symptom of sleep apnoea, but snoring alone does not establish that diagnosis.
Whatever the source of noise, one thing is certain: silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.

Pollution is the price we pay for an overpopulated, overindustrialized planet.
When you come to think about it, there are only four ways you can deal with rubbish: dump it, burn it, turn it into something you can use again, attempt to produce less of it.
We keep trying all four methods, but sheer volume of rubbish we produce worldwide threatens to overwhelm us.
Rubbish, however, is only part of the problem of polluting our planet.
The need to produce ever increasing quantities of cheap food leads to a different kind of pollution.
Industriallized farming metheods produce cheap meat products: beef, pork and chicken.
The use of pesticides and fertilizers produces cheap grain and vegetables.
The price we pay for cheap food may be already too high:
Mad Cow Disease (BSE) in cattle, salmonella in chicken and eggs, and listeria in dairy products.
And if you think you'll abandon meat and become a vegetarian, you have the choice of very expensive organically-grown vegetables or a steady diet of pesticides every time you think you're eating fresh salads and vegetables, or just having an innocent glass of water!
However, there is an even more insidious kind of pollution that particularly affects urban area and invades our daily lives, and that is noise.
Burglar alarms going off at any time of the day or night serve only to annoy passers-by and actually assist burglars to burgle.
Car alarms constantly scream at us in the street and are a source of profound irritation.
A recent survey of the effects of noise revealed (surprisingly?)
that dogs barking incessantly in the night rated the highest form of noise pollution on a scale ranging from 1 to 7.
The survey revealed a large number of sources of noise that we really dislike.
Lawn mowers whining on a summer's day, late-night parties in apartment blocks, noisy neighbours, vehicles of all kinds, especially large container trucks thundering through quiet villages, planes and helicopters flying overhead, large radios carried round in public places and played at maximum volume.
New technology has also made its own contribution to noise.
A lot of people object to mobile phones, especially when they are used in public places like restaurant or on public transport.
Loud conversations on mobile phones invade our thoughts or interrupt the pleasure of meeting friends for a quiet chat.
The noise pollution survey revealed a rather surprising and possibly amusing old-fashioned source of noise.
It turned out to be snoring! Men were found to be the worst offenders.
It was revealed that 20% of men in their mid-thirties snore.
This figure rises to a staggering 60% of men in their sixties.
Against these figures, it was found that only 5% of women snore regularly, while the rest are constantly woken or kept awake by their trumpeting partners.
Whatever the source of noise, one thing is certain: silence, it seems, has become a golden memory.

corrections.before:
编者注：本文校正教材中的食品安全论述，并删除无法确认来源的调查数字；录音保留原文。污染是人类在日益拥挤、工业化的星球上活动所带来的代价之一。
我们可以减少垃圾、重复使用或回收材料、焚烧垃圾，或采用填埋处置。
我们一直在尝试这四种方法，但全球产生的垃圾数量实在庞大，几乎让我们应接不暇。
然而，垃圾仅仅是污染我们地球问题的一个方面罢了。
食品生产也可能造成污染，具体取决于农业和废弃物的管理方式。
工业化养殖可以生产大量肉类，但安全生产需要有效的管控。
农药和肥料有助于作物生产，但滥用可能损害环境。
环境污染与食源性疾病是相互关联的问题，但两者都不能简单归因于食品价格低廉。
BSE是一种朊病毒病，1986年首次在英国牛群中确认，与受污染饲料有关。沙门氏菌和李斯特菌是可污染多种食品的细菌，并非只涉及鸡蛋或乳制品。
有机生产限制可使用的物质，但并不一定意味着完全不用农药。食品安全取决于多种因素，包括处理、储存及是否符合残留限量。
然而，还有一种更为隐蔽的污染形式，它尤其影响城市地区，并渗透到我们的日常生活中，那就是噪音。
误报或反复响起的防盗警报会令路人烦恼，不过正确使用的警报也能起到防护作用。
汽车警报声在街上不断刺耳地鸣叫，令人极度烦躁。
在困扰人们的噪声中，
夜间反复的狗叫可能格外扰人。
作者还列出了许多其他令人不快的声音：
夏日里割草机的嗡嗡声、公寓楼里的深夜聚会……吵闹的邻居们，各种各样的车辆……尤其是那些巨大的集装箱卡车，在宁静的村庄里轰鸣着驶过……飞机和直升机在头顶上飞过；在公共场所，人们会携带大型收音机，并将音量调至最大来播放音乐。
新技术也为噪音问题做出了自己的“贡献”。
很多人反对在公共场所（如餐厅或公共交通工具上）使用手机。
手机上大声的通话声会干扰我们的思绪，或者打断我们与朋友安静交谈的乐趣。
作者还补充了一种令人意外、也许有点滑稽的老式噪声来源。
那就是打鼾，它可能妨碍附近其他人的睡眠。
不同年龄和性别的人都可能打鼾。
没有可识别的研究来源和调查人群，就无法评估教材中的那些百分比。
经常大声打鼾可能是睡眠呼吸暂停的一种症状，但不能仅凭打鼾就作出诊断。
无论噪音的来源是什么，有一点是肯定的：宁静似乎已经成为了一段珍贵的回忆。
